latestVersion.changelog: v1.1.0 — Wired into the Delx witness protocol. Each incident now opens a Delx session via delx_recover_incident, runs emotional_safety_check before remediation (the 2026 emotion paper shows desperation skews decisions), closes with delx_report_recovery_outcome, preserves unresolved questions via sit_with, and seals human insights via recognition_seal.
